stays.name: Shibuya City Hotel
stays.notes: Check-in after 3 PM and check-out before 11 AM. Luggage storage is available before check-in.

stays.name: Kyoto Central Hotel
stays.notes: Check-in after 3 PM and check-out before 11 AM. Kyoto Station is within walking distance.

stays.name: Namba City Hotel
stays.notes: Check-in after 3 PM and check-out before 11 AM. Convenient for Dotonbori and Namba.

days.title: Flying to Japan
days.summary: Begin the journey to Japan with an overnight international flight.

items.title: Arrive at the airport
items.description: Arrive at the departure airport with enough time for international check-in, immigration and security.

items.title: Flight to Tokyo
items.description: Depart for Tokyo on an overnight international flight. Keep your passport, immigration documents and essential items in your cabin baggage.

days.title: Welcome to Tokyo
days.summary: Arrive in Tokyo, check in and experience Shibuya after dark.

items.title: Arrive in Tokyo
items.description: Arrive at Tokyo Haneda Airport. Complete immigration, collect baggage and prepare for the journey into central Tokyo.

items.title: Transfer to Shibuya
items.description: Travel from Haneda Airport into Tokyo and leave your luggage at the hotel if the room is not ready.

items.title: Japanese lunch
items.description: Have your first Japanese lunch in Shibuya. Ramen, sushi or a simple teishoku set are good options after the flight.

items.title: Hotel check-in
items.description: Check into the hotel, unpack and take some time to recover from the overnight journey.

items.title: Shibuya Crossing
items.description: Experience one of Tokyo's most recognizable intersections and explore the surrounding shopping streets.

items.title: Shibuya evening
items.description: Explore Shibuya's neon-lit streets, department stores and restaurants before returning to the hotel.

days.title: Traditional Tokyo
days.summary: Explore Asakusa, Senso-ji and the Tokyo Skytree before an evening in Akihabara.

items.title: Senso-ji Temple
items.description: Start the morning at Senso-ji, Tokyo's oldest temple. Walk through Kaminarimon Gate and Nakamise-dori before exploring the temple grounds.

items.title: Asakusa streets
items.description: Explore traditional shops and small food stalls around Asakusa.

items.title: Lunch in Asakusa
items.description: Try tempura, soba or another traditional Japanese lunch.

items.title: Tokyo Skytree
items.description: Visit Tokyo Skytree for panoramic views across the Tokyo metropolitan area.

items.title: Akihabara
items.description: Explore Akihabara's electronics stores, gaming shops, anime stores and arcades.

items.title: Dinner in Akihabara
items.description: Have dinner around Akihabara before returning to Shibuya.

days.title: Modern Tokyo
days.summary: Explore Meiji Shrine, Harajuku, Omotesando and Shinjuku.

items.title: Meiji Shrine
items.description: Walk through the forested grounds of Meiji Shrine and experience one of Tokyo's most important Shinto sites.

items.title: Harajuku
items.description: Explore Takeshita Street and the surrounding Harajuku neighbourhood.

items.title: Lunch in Harajuku
items.description: Enjoy lunch around Harajuku before walking towards Omotesando.

items.title: Omotesando
items.description: Walk through Omotesando and explore its architecture, fashion stores and cafés.

items.title: Shinjuku
items.description: Explore Shinjuku's skyscrapers, shopping areas and atmospheric side streets.

items.title: Omoide Yokocho
items.description: Explore the narrow lanes of Omoide Yokocho and try Japanese grilled dishes and small plates.

days.title: Tokyo to Kyoto
days.summary: Take the Shinkansen to Kyoto and spend the evening exploring Gion.

items.title: Check out of Tokyo hotel
items.description: Check out and collect your luggage before heading to Tokyo Station.

items.title: Tokyo to Kyoto by Shinkansen
items.description: Take the Tokaido Shinkansen from Tokyo Station to Kyoto Station. Keep your luggage secure and enjoy the views during the journey.

items.title: Arrive in Kyoto
items.description: Arrive at Kyoto Station and transfer to the hotel.

items.title: Hotel check-in
items.description: Check into the Kyoto hotel and leave your luggage.

items.title: Kiyomizu-dera
items.description: Visit Kiyomizu-dera and explore the historic streets around Higashiyama.

items.title: Gion
items.description: Walk through Gion and Higashiyama as the traditional streets begin to light up for the evening.

items.title: Kyoto dinner
items.description: Enjoy a traditional Kyoto-style dinner.

days.title: Classic Kyoto
days.summary: Explore Fushimi Inari, Nijo Castle and Kyoto's historic centre.

items.title: Fushimi Inari Shrine
items.description: Start early at Fushimi Inari and walk through the famous rows of vermilion torii gates.

items.title: Nishiki Market
items.description: Explore Nishiki Market and discover Kyoto snacks, pickles, tea and local ingredients.

items.title: Market lunch
items.description: Try a selection of Kyoto street foods and small dishes around Nishiki Market.

items.title: Nijo Castle
items.description: Explore Nijo Castle and its gardens, learning about Kyoto's samurai-era history.

items.title: Pontocho Alley
items.description: Walk through Pontocho's narrow traditional alley and explore the restaurants along the Kamo River.

items.title: Dinner by the Kamo River
items.description: Enjoy an evening meal around Pontocho and the Kamo River.

days.title: Arashiyama and Bamboo Forest
days.summary: Spend the day in western Kyoto exploring Arashiyama and its temples.

items.title: Arashiyama Bamboo Grove
items.description: Visit the famous bamboo grove early in the morning before the area becomes busy.

items.title: Tenryu-ji Temple
items.description: Explore Tenryu-ji Temple and its landscaped garden.

items.title: Arashiyama streets
items.description: Walk through the traditional streets of Arashiyama and browse local shops.

items.title: Kyoto lunch
items.description: Enjoy a casual Japanese lunch around Arashiyama.

items.title: Togetsukyo Bridge
items.description: Walk across the historic Togetsukyo Bridge and enjoy views of the surrounding mountains.

items.title: Return to central Kyoto
items.description: Return to the hotel and enjoy a relaxed evening.

items.title: Kyoto izakaya
items.description: Try a casual Japanese izakaya for dinner.

days.title: Kyoto to Osaka
days.summary: Travel to Osaka and spend the evening exploring Dotonbori.

items.title: Check out of Kyoto hotel
items.description: Check out and travel to Kyoto Station.

items.title: Kyoto to Osaka
items.description: Take a local or rapid train from Kyoto to Osaka. The journey is short, making Osaka an easy next stop.

items.title: Hotel luggage drop
items.description: Leave luggage at the hotel before exploring Osaka.

items.title: Kuromon Market
items.description: Explore Kuromon Market and sample Osaka's seafood, street food and local specialties.

items.title: Hotel check-in
items.description: Check into the Namba hotel and take a short break.

items.title: Dotonbori
items.description: Explore Dotonbori's neon signs, canal, restaurants and famous Glico Running Man sign.

items.title: Osaka street food
items.description: Try Osaka specialties such as takoyaki and okonomiyaki.

days.title: Osaka Castle and Umeda
days.summary: Discover Osaka's history before enjoying the city's modern skyline.

items.title: Osaka Castle
items.description: Explore Osaka Castle and the surrounding park.

items.title: Osaka lunch
items.description: Have lunch around Osaka Castle before continuing into the city.

items.title: Umeda
items.description: Explore Osaka's Umeda district, shopping centres and modern architecture.

items.title: Umeda Sky Building
items.description: Visit the observation area of Umeda Sky Building for views over Osaka.

items.title: Dinner in Umeda
items.description: Enjoy dinner around Umeda and explore the area's evening atmosphere.

days.title: Nara Day Trip
days.summary: Take a day trip to Nara to see the deer and historic temples.

items.title: Train to Nara
items.description: Travel from Osaka to Nara by train for a full day exploring the historic city.

items.title: Nara Park
items.description: Walk through Nara Park and see the famous free-roaming deer.

items.title: Todai-ji Temple
items.description: Visit Todai-ji and its enormous Great Buddha statue.

items.title: Nara lunch
items.description: Have lunch in Nara and try local dishes.

items.title: Kasuga Taisha
items.description: Walk through the forest to Kasuga Taisha and explore its lantern-lined grounds.

items.title: Return to Osaka
items.description: Return to Namba and enjoy a relaxed final evening in Osaka.

items.title: Final Osaka dinner
items.description: Enjoy one final Japanese dinner around Namba.

days.title: Fly Home
days.summary: Enjoy breakfast, check out and head to Kansai International Airport.

items.title: Breakfast
items.description: Have a final Japanese breakfast and prepare for departure.

items.title: Hotel checkout
items.description: Check out of the hotel, collect your luggage and head towards Kansai International Airport.

items.title: Transfer to Kansai Airport
items.description: Travel from Namba to Kansai International Airport using the airport train service.

items.title: Flight home
items.description: Depart Osaka and begin the journey home.
